correctness.rationale: Area quadratic form is exact for planar support functions in H1; the stadium curvature measure gives a vanishing cross term from matching perimeter and selected width. Weighted Fourier Parseval and the telescoping sum provide the inequality. Finite smooth Fourier perturbations preserve convexity and exact fixed width for small amplitude; sharpness ratio tends to 3/(2π). The constant-width endpoint restricts to odd modes and gives 1/(2π). A standalone independent numerical integral check corroborates six finite cutoffs.
